newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Gaston County, N.C.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Gaston County, N.C.

text.p: General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North
Carolina 27603-1385, until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of $31,350,000 Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997, of the County of Gaston, North Carolina, dated May 1, 1997 and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) annually, May 1, $1,200,000 1998 to 2007, inclusive, $1,750,000 2008 to 2015, inclusive, $2,100,000 2016 and $3,250,000 2017.

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The bonds will be delivered on or about May 6, 1997.
